name: Unbilled-Time Catcher

parameters.content:
## Unbilled-Time Catcher

### How it works

This workflow has TWO independent parts on one canvas:

**A. Daily unbilled activity check (top row)**
Runs every morning, checking the previous day. Pulls every Clio calendar entry from that day and cross-references it against logged time entries, at the matter level — any matter with a calendar entry but zero time entries that day gets flagged. Groups the results by responsible attorney and emails each one a nudge to review and log their time.

**B. Weekly revenue-impact summary (bottom row)**
Runs weekly, independently. Re-runs the same detection over the trailing 7 days and emails the firm a rough estimate of how much unbilled activity is worth, using a configurable hourly rate — the 'firms only bill 2.4 of 8 hours' leak made visible in dollar terms.

**This never creates a time entry or decides what to bill.** It only ever flags that SOMETHING happened on a matter with no matching time entry — the attorney reviews and logs the actual entry themselves, with their own narrative and judgment about what's billable. There is no code path here that writes to Clio's time-entry data (ABA Op. 512 — surfacing a gap, never drafting or deciding billing content).

**Coverage today is calendar entries only.** Logged calls and emails (Clio's Communications) are a natural extension — not built here yet (coming soon) — since their exact API shape hasn't been confirmed against a live account the way calendar entries have in this catalog.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Set up the Bar-Compliance Guardrail (NTC-33) first — both branches' audit logging goes through it.
- [ ] Configure Clio OAuth2 and SMTP credentials.
- [ ] Set the required n8n Variables: CLIO_BASE_URL, FIRM_NAME, FIRM_EMAIL, FIRM_FROM_EMAIL, GUARDRAIL_WORKFLOW_ID.
- [ ] Optionally tune DEFAULT_CALENDAR_DURATION_HOURS and DEFAULT_HOURLY_RATE — see the deploy guide.
- [ ] Activate the workflow.

### Customization

The estimated dollar figures in the weekly summary are exactly that — estimates, using a single firm-wide DEFAULT_HOURLY_RATE and a default duration for calendar entries with no clear start/end time. They're meant to communicate the scale of the leak, not to be billed directly.

## Flag matter activity with no matching time entry

Checks yesterday's calendar entries against logged time entries and nudges each attorney about matters with activity but nothing billed.

## Weekly revenue-impact summary — a second, independent branch

Re-runs the same check over the trailing week and puts a rough dollar figure on the firm's unbilled-time leak.

nodes.name: Check For Unbilled Activity Daily
nodes.notes: Runs every morning at 7am by default, checking the previous day's activity.

nodes.name: Fetch Prior Day Calendar Entries From Clio
nodes.notes: Every calendar entry tied to a matter from the previous day.

nodes.name: Fetch Prior Day Time Entries From Clio
nodes.notes: Every time entry actually logged for the previous day — used to check which matters already have billed activity. Confirm the from_date/to_date parameter names against a real response on first live test; Clio's exact activities.json filtering has not been independently confirmed live in this catalog yet.

nodes.name: Fetch Open Matters For Unbilled Check
nodes.notes: Used to resolve which attorney is responsible for each matter with unbilled activity, for grouping the digest emails.

nodes.name: Find Unbilled Calendar Activity
nodes.notes: The core detection logic. DEFAULT_CALENDAR_DURATION_HOURS is used only when a calendar entry has no clear start/end time — defaults to 0.5.

nodes.name: Group Unbilled Activity By Attorney
nodes.notes: Runs once for the whole batch, not once per item — turns the flat list of unbilled matters into one summary item per attorney.

nodes.name: Build Unbilled Time Digest Email
nodes.notes: One email per attorney listing every unbilled matter from yesterday, with a rough hours estimate per item.

nodes.name: Log Digest For Compliance Audit
nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget audit logging only — this goes to the firm's own attorney, not a client, so the guardrail's approval result is deliberately ignored, same internal-notification pattern used throughout this catalog.

nodes.name: Send Unbilled Time Digest Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Unbilled Time Digest Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Fetch Weekly Calendar Entries From Clio
nodes.notes: Same calendar data as the daily branch, just over the trailing 7 days instead of 1.

nodes.name: Fetch Weekly Time Entries From Clio
nodes.notes: Same as the daily branch's time-entry fetch, just over the trailing 7 days.

nodes.name: Fetch Open Matters For Weekly Summary
nodes.notes: Same as the daily branch's matter fetch, used here for the weekly detection pass.

nodes.name: Find Unbilled Calendar Activity For Week
nodes.notes: Same detection logic as the daily branch, applied to the week's data.

nodes.name: Compute Weekly Unbilled Revenue Impact
nodes.notes: DEFAULT_HOURLY_RATE controls the dollar estimate — set it to your firm's typical blended rate.

nodes.name: Build Weekly Unbilled Revenue Summary Email
nodes.notes: Explicitly sends a 'nothing to flag' message rather than a zero-filled or empty digest when the week was clean.

nodes.name: Log Weekly Summary For Compliance Audit
nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget audit logging only — internal firm summary, not a client communication.

nodes.name: Send Weekly Unbilled Revenue Summary Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Weekly Unbilled Revenue Summary Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

description: Runs on two independent daily/weekly schedules. Daily: cross-references the previous day's Clio calendar entries against logged time entries at the matter level, flags matters with activity but no time entry, and emails each responsible attorney a digest grouped by matter. Weekly (separate): re-runs the same check over the trailing 7 days and emails the firm a rough dollar estimate of the unbilled-time leak using a configurable hourly rate. Never creates a time entry or drafts billing content -- only ever flags a gap for the attorney to review and log themselves (ABA Op. 512). Replaces LeanLaw and manual review, surfacing the hours firms lose simply by not tracking activity against time entries.
